desc: The Equalizer is an S&W high-capacity, micro-compact. The pistol features an easy to rack slide with deep slide serrations, front and back; slide is cut for optics; fires 10rd magazine, 13rd magazine or a 15rd magazine; grip safety; no manual thumb safety; loaded chamber indicator; SA trigger with tactile and audible reset; Drift adjustable, white dot sights; Picatinny style rail; disassembles without pulling the trigger and an Armornite corrosion resistant finish.
